paper.title: Exact solution of a 1D asymmetric exclusion model using a matrix formulation
paper.journal: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General 26(7):1493-1517

headline: TASEP open boundaries (DEHP 1993, CA): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; maximal-current plateau J=0.251~0.25 (worst |J-0.25|=0.001), low-density J=0.210~a(1-a) rho=0.301~a, coexistence density jump 0.36 on crossing

verdicts.gate: P1 maximal-current plateau: |J - 0.25| <= 0.02 at every (alpha,beta) with alpha,beta > 0.5 (J independent of alpha,beta)
P2 low-density phase (alpha=0.3<beta=0.8): J ~= alpha(1-alpha) AND rho ~= alpha, each within +/-0.03
P3 coexistence: alpha=beta=0.3 profile roughly linear (R^2 >= 0.85) AND lowering beta to 0.15 flips bulk rho by a jump >= 0.20 (toward 1-beta)

extra.framing_detail: totally asymmetric simple exclusion process (TASEP) — an interacting-particle / cellular-automaton stochastic hopping-exclusion rule on a 1D open lattice under random-sequential update, NOT an agent-stepping ABM (no perceive/decide/act agents, no scheduler over a roster)
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published analytically-exact model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the boundary-induced three-phase diagram of the open TASEP (the exactly-known maximal current J = 1/4, the alpha-controlled low-density current/plateau, and the coexistence-line density jump) and would catch an artifact

citations: Derrida, B., Evans, M.R., Hakim, V. & Pasquier, V. (1993). Exact solution of a 1D asymmetric exclusion model using a matrix formulation. Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General 26(7):1493-1517. doi:10.1088/0305-4470/26/7/011.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the exactly-known open-TASEP phase diagram (maximal current J=1/4, low-density J=alpha(1-alpha) & rho=alpha, coexistence-line density jump)
